annotations.title: Open a private harbour for a team

description: Open a harbour: a private sea for one team, practice or project. It starts empty; the team gives it a frame (what its machines are for and stay inside), lays in the sources it has approved, and it grows its own ways and notes. Returns three keys once (owner, crew, guest) and the address of the harbour's own MCP door, which any model can use. Nothing a harbour holds enters the open sea. Call this only when the person asked for it, and hand the keys to them.
